BL-1517 — Babashka CLIs that take `<project-root>` positionally accept a flag or a literal as the root and create it under cwd: `main_sync_status_cli.bb --help` wrote `--help/.swarmforge/daemon/` (2026-09-04), `operator_runtime.bb --tick-once` wrote `--tick-once/.swarmforge/operator/` (2026-07-13), `expedite_cli.bb` created `unpark/.swarmforge/expedite/` (2026-09-04); a shared root-argument check refuses a root that is not an existing git checkout before any directory is created
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: a root argument that begins with `-`, is blank, or is not an existing directory inside a git checkout is refused with usage and exit 2 before any directory is created; the three named C…
BL-1517 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1517" (or "reject BL-1517 <reason>") to act.
